solutions.title: Care & Companionship Solutions for Seniors
solutions.subtitle: ANTCARE delivers high-quality home healthcare and emotional companionship right at home.
solutions.card1_desc: Monitoring vital signs, managing medication schedules, and guiding mild recovery exercises.
solutions.card2_desc: Transporting, assisting hospital procedures, recording doctor instructions, and reporting to family.
solutions.card3_desc: Continuous recording of health metrics with periodic digital reports for remote family tracking.
solutions.card4_desc: Guiding home care skills, fall prevention techniques, and emergency response procedures for families.

whyUs.title: Why Hundreds of Families Trust ANTCARE?
whyUs.reason1_desc: Our Health Assistants (Ants) undergo rigorous first aid certification and elderly communication training.
whyUs.reason2_desc: Detailed reports after every home visit via Zalo/App, ensuring complete peace of mind for family members.
whyUs.reason3_desc: Listening, chatting, understanding psychology, and accompanying elderly parents like biological family.

process.title: Simple & Fast 4-Step Process
process.step1_desc: Listening to needs and evaluating the senior's health condition and daily living routines.
process.step2_desc: Designing a tailored care roadmap suited for each individual elder and family condition.
process.step3_desc: Selecting the ideal Health Assistant matching personality, expertise, and living area.
process.step4_desc: Conducting weekly care visits and sending direct health metric reports to family.
